TABLE.NAME: quizgeist
TABLE.COMMENT: Activity instances and their default settings

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Text format of the activity description

FIELD.NAME: season
FIELD.COMMENT: Season used by the jahreszeiten theme

FIELD.NAME: allowbacktrack
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether players may navigate back to earlier questions

FIELD.NAME: grademethod
FIELD.COMMENT: Aggregation method: best, last or average

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum grade, negative scale ID, or zero when grading is disabled

FIELD.NAME: pacemode
FIELD.COMMENT: Point axis orthogonal to the play mode: timed keeps the response-time component, even removes it while keeping the streak

FIELD.NAME: leaderboard
FIELD.COMMENT: Server-side leaderboard visibility: own, team or full

FIELD.NAME: timervisible
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the countdown is shown to players

FIELD.NAME: soundenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the generated sound engine may play at all

FIELD.NAME: friendlynew
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether questions carrying the reserved topic tag neu use the error-friendly framing

FIELD.NAME: reasonstep
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity default for the reason stage between answer and reveal

FIELD.NAME: explanationpolicy
FIELD.COMMENT: Worked-solution disclosure policy: immediate, atend or never

FIELD.NAME: completionpercent
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum percentage required for completion; zero disables the rule

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_imports
TABLE.COMMENT: Idempotent external-source imports and their teacher-facing reports

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Target course used for course-wide idempotence

FIELD.NAME: sourcehash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the canonical source document

FIELD.NAME: adaptedcount
FIELD.COMMENT: Questions retained with a documented adaptation

FIELD.NAME: skippedcount
FIELD.COMMENT: Questions that could not be represented

FIELD.NAME: mediacount
FIELD.COMMENT: Source media retained in Moodle file storage

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_questions
TABLE.COMMENT: Ordered questions, content slides and their type-specific JSON options

FIELD.NAME: rootid
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable root question ID shared by every content version

FIELD.NAME: version
FIELD.COMMENT: One-based content version within the question lineage

FIELD.NAME: optionsjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Answers and type-specific options as JSON

FIELD.NAME: timelimit
FIELD.COMMENT: Time limit in seconds; zero means no limit

FIELD.NAME: pointmode
FIELD.COMMENT: Point mode: standard, double or none

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Editorial status: draft, media_pending, ready or archived

FIELD.NAME: createdby
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the content; nullable when anonymised

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_sessions
TABLE.COMMENT: Server-side state machine for live sessions

FIELD.NAME: mode
FIELD.COMMENT: Classic, accuracy, team or safety mode

FIELD.NAME: stateversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Monotonic version used for efficient polling

FIELD.NAME: statejson
FIELD.COMMENT: Compact reconnect-safe session state as JSON

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_session_questions
TABLE.COMMENT: Immutable question sequence and current visit state for each live session

FIELD.NAME: sortindex
FIELD.COMMENT: Zero-based immutable position in the played sequence

FIELD.NAME: visit
FIELD.COMMENT: Current or most recent visit token for this position

FIELD.NAME: visitstate
FIELD.COMMENT: Visit state: pending, active, revealed or skipped

FIELD.NAME: resolvedvisit
FIELD.COMMENT: Visit token whose revealed result is authoritative

FIELD.NAME: stage
FIELD.COMMENT: Current type-owned interaction stage for this position

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_players
TABLE.COMMENT: Authenticated players participating in a live session

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user represented by this player

FIELD.NAME: displayname
FIELD.COMMENT: Real, chosen or generated session display name

FIELD.NAME: groupid
FIELD.COMMENT: Mapped Moodle group, when team mode uses course groups

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_assignments
TABLE.COMMENT: Self-learning assignments and challenge settings

FIELD.NAME: mode
FIELD.COMMENT: Solo, practice, test or flashcards mode

FIELD.NAME: timedue
FIELD.COMMENT: Due timestamp; zero means no deadline

FIELD.NAME: createdby
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the assignment; nullable when anonymised

FIELD.NAME: selection
FIELD.COMMENT: fixed freezes exact question versions; due freezes question roots and resolves the current version when an attempt starts

FIELD.NAME: settingsjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Assignment and reminder settings as JSON

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_assignment_questions
TABLE.COMMENT: Immutable exact question-version snapshot for each self-learning assignment

FIELD.NAME: sortindex
FIELD.COMMENT: Zero-based immutable position in the assignment

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Exact frozen question version; authoritative only while the owning assignment has selection=fixed

FIELD.NAME: rootid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question root; authoritative for selection=due assignments, whose version is resolved when an attempt starts

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_attempts
TABLE.COMMENT: Self-learning attempts including navigation and flashcard stacks

FIELD.NAME: attemptnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Sequential attempt number per user and assignment

FIELD.NAME: statejson
FIELD.COMMENT: Current server-owned navigation state as JSON

FIELD.NAME: flashcardsjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Known and repeat flashcard stacks as JSON

FIELD.NAME: remindedat
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the deadline reminder; zero if none was sent

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_attempt_questions
TABLE.COMMENT: Exact frozen question versions, drafts and disclosure state for self-learning attempts

FIELD.NAME: sortindex
FIELD.COMMENT: Zero-based immutable position in this attempt

FIELD.NAME: answerjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Validated canonical test draft before final submission

FIELD.NAME: timestarted
FIELD.COMMENT: First time this position was opened

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last draft or disclosure state change

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_answers
TABLE.COMMENT: Append-only live and self-learning responses

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Live session; set only for a live response

FIELD.NAME: playerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Live player; set only for a live response

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: Self-learning attempt; set only for a solo response

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user who submitted this response

FIELD.NAME: answertype
FIELD.COMMENT: Answer, scorevoid, moderation, reaction, idea, group, vote, reason or stage; reason is the never-scored think-moment justification and stage the never-scored marker of a completed stage check

FIELD.NAME: visit
FIELD.COMMENT: Opaque live or self-learning question visit token

FIELD.NAME: submissionkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Client idempotency key for repeatable live interactions

FIELD.NAME: iscorrect
FIELD.COMMENT: Correctness, or null for ungraded content

FIELD.NAME: maxpoints
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum points available for this exact response

INDEX.NAME: live_submission_uix
INDEX.FIELDS: sessionid, playerid, questionid, visit, answertype, submissionkey

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_assignment_reminders
TABLE.COMMENT: Bounded deadline reminder delivery ledger

FIELD.NAME: attemptcount
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of Moodle message delivery attempts

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_goals
TABLE.COMMENT: Personal weekly question targets per activity

FIELD.NAME: quizgeistid
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity whose self-learning progress is targeted

FIELD.NAME: target
FIELD.COMMENT: Questions to finish in one calendar week

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_templates
TABLE.COMMENT: School-wide reusable quiz template snapshots

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_rewards
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-user avatar and accessory unlocks

FIELD.NAME: quizgeistid
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity that granted the reward, when applicable

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_tags
TABLE.COMMENT: Reusable topic, question-type and competence labels owned by an activity, a course or the site

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: Ownership scope: activity, course or site

FIELD.NAME: scopeid
FIELD.COMMENT: Quizgeist activity ID, course ID, or zero for site scope

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: Label family: topic, qtype or competence

FIELD.NAME: tagkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable machine key limited to a-z, 0-9, hyphen and underscore

FIELD.NAME: externalref
FIELD.COMMENT: External reference such as a LehrplanPLUS locator

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Zero-based display order inside its kind

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_question_tags
TABLE.COMMENT: Tag assignments bound to the question root, never to a content version

FIELD.NAME: quizgeistid
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised owning activity for fast activity-wide reads

FIELD.NAME: rootid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question root ID; deliberately not the version ID so an edit keeps the tag

FIELD.NAME: weight
FIELD.COMMENT: Relative weight from 0 to 100: main competence versus secondary reference

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: approved by a teacher, or suggested by a learner in the question workshop

FIELD.NAME: createdby
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the assignment; nullable when anonymised

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_schedule
TABLE.COMMENT: SM-2 repetition state per learner and question root; owned by the base so it stays readable, exportable and erasable without the self-study addon

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Learner the repetition state belongs to

FIELD.NAME: rootid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question root ID; deliberately not the version ID so an edit keeps the learning state

FIELD.NAME: easiness
FIELD.COMMENT: SM-2 ease factor times one hundred; never below 130

FIELD.NAME: lapses
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of times the repetition chain was reset

FIELD.NAME: duetime
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of the next repetition; zero means due immediately

FIELD.NAME: lastreviewed
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of the last observed response

FIELD.NAME: lastquality
FIELD.COMMENT: Last mapped SM-2 quality from zero to five

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_misconceptions
TABLE.COMMENT: Teacher-authored misconception labels per distractor of a question root; course content without any user column

FIELD.NAME: rootid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question root ID; deliberately not the version ID so an edit keeps the label

FIELD.NAME: answerkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Canonical answer ID of the root question, validated against its options

FIELD.NAME: label
FIELD.COMMENT: Plain-text misconception label shown to the teacher only

FIELD.NAME: hint
FIELD.COMMENT: Plain-text next-step hint for the teacher

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_workshop
TABLE.COMMENT: Question workshop submissions; the question itself stays an ordinary draft row in quizgeist_questions

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Exact draft version the learner submitted

FIELD.NAME: rootid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question root ID; the submission survives every later edit

FIELD.NAME: curatornote
FIELD.COMMENT: Plain-text curation note for the learner

FIELD.NAME: aicheckjson
FIELD.COMMENT: AI pre-check result; always advisory, never a decision

FIELD.NAME: timedecided
FIELD.COMMENT: Curation decision timestamp; zero while undecided

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_workshop_ratings
TABLE.COMMENT: Peer ratings of a workshop submission; one rating per learner and submission, enforced by a unique index

FIELD.NAME: quality
FIELD.COMMENT: Perceived quality from one to five

FIELD.NAME: difficulty
FIELD.COMMENT: Perceived difficulty from one to five

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_clips
TABLE.COMMENT: Short audio clips (U3). The audio itself lives in the clipaudio file area; this row is its bookkeeping and, once the retention task ran, its only remains

FIELD.NAME: answerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Bound live or self-study answer; null while the clip is still unbound

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: Item ID inside the clipaudio file area

FIELD.NAME: durationms
FIELD.COMMENT: Duration read server-side from the container, never taken from a client field

FIELD.NAME: language
FIELD.COMMENT: Requested recognition language; carried through so a multilingual service later is configuration, not a rebuild (E-12)

FIELD.NAME: transcript
FIELD.COMMENT: Plain-text transcript; outlives the audio on purpose

FIELD.NAME: transcriptstate
FIELD.COMMENT: none, pending, done, failed or declined

FIELD.NAME: transcriptcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Machine code for diagnosis; never rendered directly (F16)

FIELD.NAME: audiodeleted
FIELD.COMMENT: Time at which the retention task removed the audio; zero while it is still there

KEY.NAME: answer_fk
KEY.COMMENT: A clip belongs to at most one answer; the key enforces it, not the application logic

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_curriculum_refs
TABLE.COMMENT: LehrplanPLUS anchor of one question root (F10). Course content, not user data: it survives a course reset

FIELD.NAME: rootid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question root ID; the anchor survives every later edit

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Year group; zero when the draft was generated without curriculum grounding

FIELD.NAME: learningarea
FIELD.COMMENT: Learning area of the cited chunk

FIELD.NAME: citationurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Absolute LehrplanPLUS URL including its anchor fragment

FIELD.NAME: chunkid
FIELD.COMMENT: Originating local_planung chunk; purely diagnostic, never dereferenced

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_cardsets
TABLE.COMMENT: Printable answer-card set of one class (F11a). Course content, not user data: the sheet a teacher printed survives a course reset

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher-facing set name, usually the class

FIELD.NAME: seed
FIELD.COMMENT: Deterministic code seed; a reprint yields the SAME cards

FIELD.NAME: createdby
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher who created the set; released on course reset

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_cards
TABLE.COMMENT: One printed card of one set (F11a). userid null means a reserve card for a guest

FIELD.NAME: cardindex
FIELD.COMMENT: Zero-based position inside the set; the code is derived from it and print order follows it

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Card holder; null marks a reserve card

FIELD.NAME: cardcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Error-detecting code printed on the card

INDEX.NAME: set_code_uix
INDEX.COMMENT: A code identifies at most one card of a set; the index enforces it, not the application logic

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_card_scans
TABLE.COMMENT: One camera scan of one live question (F11a). Volatile raw data: the picture lives in the cardscan file area, is never served through quizgeist_pluginfile() and is deleted as soon as the scan is evaluated (E-10)

FIELD.NAME: quizgeistid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning Quizgeist activity; carried so the retention task can resolve a context without joining sessions

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Live session the scan belongs to

FIELD.NAME: cardsetid
FIELD.COMMENT: Card set the codes are looked up in

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: Item ID inside the cardscan file area; equals the scan ID

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, recognised, confirmed, failed or discarded

FIELD.NAME: reasoncode
FIELD.COMMENT: Machine code for diagnosis; never rendered directly (F16)

FIELD.NAME: resultjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Validated recognition result as JSON list of {cardcode, answerKey, confidence, box}

FIELD.NAME: recognised
FIELD.COMMENT: Cards accepted by the plugin's own boundary; never larger than expected

FIELD.NAME: expected
FIELD.COMMENT: Cards of the set that could have appeared

FIELD.NAME: imagedeleted
FIELD.COMMENT: Time at which the picture was removed; zero while it is still there. This column is what makes the deletion provable

TABLE.NAME: quizgeist_stage_reports
TABLE.COMMENT: One stage-check report (F13). Metrics only: neither the video nor a single raw body landmark ever reaches this row, because neither ever leaves the device

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Exact question version presented; a report is the snapshot of a performance, like an answer, and therefore hangs on the version and not on the root

FIELD.NAME: answerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Answer the presentation belonged to; null for a slide, which carries no answer

FIELD.NAME: durationsecs
FIELD.COMMENT: Presentation length in whole seconds, server-validated to 0..3600

FIELD.NAME: metricsjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Rebuilt, schema-safe body-language metrics; never the client JSON as it arrived

FIELD.NAME: aiused
FIELD.COMMENT: Zero for the shipped rule-based coach; reserved so a later AI coach needs no migration

FIELD.NAME: feedbackjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Ordered list of message CODES derived server-side from the metrics; codes become sentences at render time (F16)
